page_title: REN 1-3 PSG | Rennes v PSG 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Paris SG take a short corner kick.

90+5' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Steve Mandanda pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The referee signals a corner kick to Paris SG.
90+5' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Desire Doue (Rennes) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
88' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Vitinha walks off the pitch to be replaced by Carlos Soler (Paris SG).
86' Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) climbs higher than the defenders inside the box and plants a towering header against the crossbar. What a great chance!
84' The resulting set piece from Paris SG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

84' CHANCE! Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot to the left side of the goal, but Steve Mandanda produces an excellent save. Now Paris SG have a corner.
82' A tremendous drive by Bradley Barcola (Paris SG) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Steve Mandanda makes a brilliant save.
79' Vitinha (Paris SG) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

79' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Paris SG manage to earn a corner.
76' Amine Gouiri comes off the pitch to be replaced by Martin Terrier (Rennes).

76' Ambitious effort from Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
75' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Manuel Ugarte and he is replaced by Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG).
75' A substitution has been made. Ousmane Dembele is replaced by Bradley Barcola (Paris SG).
74' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Gianluigi Donnarumma, who smothers the ball.
72' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nemanja Matic (Rennes) heads on.
72' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
71' Bruno Genesio prepares a substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo is replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
71' Substitution. Fabian Rieder walks off the pitch and Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.
70' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' Fabian Rieder (Rennes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Rennes win a corner kick.
66' Ludovic Blas will be replaced by Desire Doue (Rennes).
66' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Jeanuel Belocian will be replaced by Adrien Truffert (Rennes).
63' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
58' 1 - 3 Goal! Achraf Hakimi plays a pass to the feet of Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 1:3.
57' Substitution. Goncalo Ramos will be replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG).
56' 1 - 2 Amine Gouiri (Rennes) jumps for a cross and plants a crashing header into the middle of the net. Even though the goalkeeper was standing near, he couldn't make a save.
55' Paris SG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
55' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) inside the box. Rennes have a corner.
53' Vitinha (Paris SG) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Bastien interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

51' What a wasted opportunity by Lorenz Assignon (Rennes)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
50' Good chance for Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the right post.
49' Unlucky! A great strike from Amine Gouiri (Rennes) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A quickly taken corner by Paris SG.

45+2' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The linesman points to the corner flag, Paris SG are going to take it.
45+1' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) takes the corner with a short pass.
45+1' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes out of play. Paris SG are awarded a corner kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' It must be a yellow card. It is. Warmed Omari (Rennes) receives the caution after an awful tackle.

41' That didn't go as planned! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Gianluigi Donnarumma, who easily kept it out.
39' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
36' 0 - 2 Goal! Warren Zaire-Emery picks out Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom right corner with a header from close range. 0:2.
32' 0 - 1 Vitinha (Paris SG) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it flies straight into the top right corner of the net!
32' 37:63 – the latest ball possession ratio.
29' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) makes a strong challenge and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul.
28' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.
24' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

24' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Paris SG have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
22' Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) is penalised for a foul. Benoit Bastien had a clear view and blows his whistle.
21' Vitinha (Paris SG) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
16' Rennes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gianluigi Donnarumma intercepts the ball.
9' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle. Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) commits a foul after dangerous play.
7' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

6' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the left side of the target.
4' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
3' The Paris SG players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Rennes will take the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
